Android proposal: visible S width 50.5dp, height 48.32dp in the 108dp layer (about 478.8 × 458.1px on 1024px). Approximately +11.35% relative to the current prepared body. Preview enlargement only: existing foreground files remain unchanged. All high-opacity source pixels fit the illustrated 72dp circular viewport, but some tips extend beyond the conservative 66dp circle. A few very faint pixels may be masked. Device/motion testing remains required; no universal mask guarantee.
